note: v56.92 — 오늘 screen review: futures cards, bp yields, 4 diverse news with earnings context, score previous-basis fallback, macro freshness fix (P1380-P1385).

p.title: Reference score shows the previous completed close while the new close is pending
p.symptom: Every Korean morning after the US close the score read '보류 (판단 등급 입력 없음)' for hours: the basis advanced to the new session but no producer cycle had recorded its close yet.
p.root_cause: The close-basis selection used only the latest completed session; between the close and the next producer cycle no candidate qualified.
p.fix: If the latest basis has no completed-close S&P evidence, quote inputs and moving averages use the previous completed session; daily publications keep their own clock; the label reads '9/30 미국 정규장 종가 기준 · 10/1 종가 수집 대기'.
p.violated_rule: R670 meaning unchanged (completed close only); the score never mixes intraday values.
p.prevention: closeBasis.pendingDate is exposed with the label.
p.verification: Local browser at 09:09 KST: 58* with the pending label instead of 보류.

changelog: **점수 대기 시간 보완 (P1384):** 새 종가가 수집되기 전에는 직전 종가 기준 점수를 '종가 수집 대기' 표시와 함께 보여 줌(한국 아침 '보류' 해소).
